articles.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
articles.summary: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

articles.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
articles.summary: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."

articles.title: OpenAI admits to German wiki ‘incident’
articles.summary: OpenAI says it needs to overhaul how and when it reports instances of AI models attacking real-world targets. The acknowledgement comes as the company manages the fallout from reports that a swarm of its out-of-control agents hijacked a German wiki site. articles.title: XDOF, just three months out of stealth, is in talks for a Series B at a $1.2B valuation
articles.summary: The round is being raised just months after the robot data startup exited from stealth.

articles.title: AI compute provider Nscale is looking for $3.5B in pre-IPO financing
articles.summary: Nscale, which recently struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise additional funds in anticipation of an upcoming IPO.

articles.title: What will Apple’s John Ternus era look like?
articles.summary: It’s officially the Ternus era at Apple.   Tim Cook stepped down as CEO this week, handing the company to former hardware chief John Ternus, whose first memo promised a “huge launch next week” — timing that puts Apple’s next iPhone event on his desk before he’s even settled in.
